# Apache ECharts (offline vendor copy)

- Version: 6.1.0
- License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`)
- Source: https://github.com/apache/echarts/releases/tag/6.1.0

Use the local browser build when the reports module is migrated to ECharts:

```html
<script src="/assets/vendor/echarts/echarts.min.js"></script>
```

This copy is intentionally pinned so the application does not need a CDN or internet connection to render charts.
